Terms and Conditions 1. The contract shall be on comprehensive basis, inclusive of repairs and repla cement of the spare parts including batteries without any extra cost and expens es to the Institute. The service provider shall carry out quarterly routine service s, preventive maintenance and breakdown maintenance for Lift covered under t he ACMC. The scope of Annual Comprehensive Maintenance Service covers upk eep and smooth working of the lift within the premises of Institute. 2. Service provide may depute/engage a suitable team to visit the Institute before biding if required to fully understand the job during the execution of the work. The site visits shall be entirely at service providers own cost and expens e. 3. During ACMC, service provider shall carry out four number of service per year contract. 4. During ACMC the service provider shall also carry out one number of pre ventive maintenance (overhauling) service. 5. Break Down Services/Repair. As and when required. 6. No work will be undertaken on closed holidays and beyond office hours on any day except by prior approval/direction of the Institute. 7. Response Time. All complaint/repairs should be attended and resol ved within 12 hours to 24 hours 8. Payment Terms (a) The payment will be made to ACMC service provider on quarterl y basis (if the services are satisfactory) on submission of bill by the vendo r on completion of each quarter (c) Enhancement or decrease of taxes, duties or prices of componen ts etc, will not affect the ACMC rates during the entire period of ACMC. 9.
